messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — Increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate from eu-west-1. 10% errors over the last minute. Pagerduty: ENG-INFERENCE.

maria: Acknowledged. I'm primary for this shift, taking point. spinning up diagnostics now.

sam: I'm secondary — here for pager escalations and backup. ping me if we need hotfix or region failover.

maria: quick snapshot: 5xx looks like upstream tensor runtime OOMs on g4dn. relogging shows 'KV cache miss -> memory spike'. attaching minimal logs below.

maria: ```
2024-05-27T14:05:12Z inference-runtime error: allocation failed: requested 2.1GB, available 1.4GB
stack: runtime/kernel.c:213 load_kv_cache
request: model=redwood-open-7b seq=1024
```

tj: FYI — I'm out for first hour of my swing (stuck in client call). can cover read-only checks but can't do deployments until 15:00Z. there's a 2h coverage gap if you need someone to approve emergency infra oncall.

maria: noted. Sam — can you hold the deployment permission and PD escalation to infra lead if we need node reboots?

sam: Yep. If we need to reboot a host or apply kernel knob, escalate to infra-oncall and page infra-lead (leo). I'll open an incident bridge if this stays noisy >10m.

maria: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/kv-cache-oom (use the 'apply-ephemeral-cache' section). Steps I'm doing now: 1) disable long-context batching, 2) apply temp quantization switch for the hot model, 3) move traffic to eu-central if healthy.

anya: Quick reminder — customer-impact triage: mark impacted tenants in incident ticket. If >3 paying teams see errors or latency >2m, classify as customer-impact and update status.

maria: Doing canary traffic shift to eu-central at 14:12Z for 10% of requests — rolling. monitor P95 and error rate.

incident-bot: Traffic-shift: 10% -> eu-central initiated by maria at 1716809532. New error rate on source shard: 4% (down from 10%).

maria: good signal. continuing other mitigations. if error rate drops under 2% for 5m we can keep canary and then increment. if error rate rebounds or hosts show new OOMs, escalate to SEV1 and page: @leo, @infra-oncall, and ENG-TL.

sam: Escalation matrix quick note (copy to incident ticket):
- SEV3: transient errors (<5m, <5% users) -> on-call only
- SEV2: sustained errors (>=5m or >10% of requests) -> primary + secondary + infra-oncall page
- SEV1: system-wide impact (customer outages, data loss, sustained >20% errors) -> page infra-lead (@leo), eng director, and exec oncall; open public comms

maria: Adding checklist I'm following to the ticket:
- [x] Identify faulty model / variant
- [x] Reduce batching / lower seq len
- [x] Canary traffic to secondary region
- [ ] Hotfix build (if regression) -> needs TJ approval once he's free
- [ ] Postmortem owner assigned

tj: I'll review hotfix after 15:00Z. If you need immediate rollout before then, Sam, you have permission to execute emergency deploy with rollback plan.

maria: Current action: monitoring. error rate trending down to 1.8%, P95 latency stable. keeping this thread updated every 2-3 minutes. please react with :thumbsup: if you're good with the canary.

leo: Seeing notes — thx team. I'll be on-call if escalated. keep me in loop on any infra reboots.

maria: update at 14:24Z — 30m after initial alert: error rate at 0.9% and node memory stable. closing immediate mitigation. will leave canary at 25% for 20m then fold back. assigning postmortem owner: anya.

anya: Taking postmortem. I'll collect prompts, evals, and metric windows. will schedule RCA sync tomorrow.

maria: handoff checklist before I log off: primary -> sam becomes primary watch for 30m (since I have to step out), tj remains secondary when available. notes: runbook link, temporary quantization toggle set, canary at 25%. handoff ts=1716809301

sam: Acknowledged. I am primary now and will escalate per matrix if we hit thresholds. thanks maria.

incident-bot: Thread archived: last message at 1716809301.
